_about: Sibling annotation for the TF-24 Stage-2 calibration report. That report is historical (CHANGELOG PR-S152: 'within noise, no default change') and is NOT re-run. This file classifies each DAS-derived field it used against the native DAS engine (ADR-107) and periodic quadrature (ADR-108).

das_opponent.measured_shift: same source (median / p90 / max per provider, as das_team)

das_degraded.note: native flags unscoreable frames by Reason (reason_counts in metrics.json), not the pre-ADR-043 broad-except NaN; the degrade PATH differs though the Stage-2 verdict does not

decision_unchanged_because: the per-provider DAS shift is sub-centimetre at the median (max 0.00633 m) and bounded in the tails, far below the Stage-2 'within noise' threshold.
